steps.content: Seeing that the last few monsters are almost cleared out, Lynn has just breathed a sigh of relief when EMP flips forward and lands ahead, rolling her wrists loose.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hehe, leave the cleanup to me!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief! I'm gonna make this look good! One shot and take 'em all out!
EMP launches herself high into the air, arcs of lightning coiling and dancing across the arrow in her grasp.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Watch this! You forced me to do this!

The slime at the front is pinned and bursts apart on the spot. The burning creatures have their cores pierced one after another, and even the monsters cowering at the very back are caught before they can react, skewered clean through in the same breath.
And yet something still nags at you, until your gaze lands on Murphy beside you, swept up in the fervor and openly cheering EMP on.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: EMP! You've got this! No wonder you're the Archer Queen of Syndicate!
Murphy freezes for a beat, then springs backward as though something just clicked in her mind.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: But... it's just cheering, right? That should be... fine...?
Before you can finish, the ground shudders beneath you. Then comes a second tremor. Then a third.
A pair of blazing golden eyes flare to life in the darkness. Moments later, a round silhouette comes rumbling out from the depths of the shadows.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Wh-what the hell is that thing?! Murphy! Don't you EVER cheer for me again!
